name: Serial Killers Anonymous
source:
Best friends Mikee and Pancho are attending a Halloween party in a manor on the mountains. Mikee is determined to confess a longstanding crush on Julia, fellow college senior and host of the gathering. When Julia wanders off, Mikee follows her down to the basement, where shocking secrets await.

[From [url=https://orcamartiangames.itch.io/serial-killers-anonymous]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
最好的朋友米基和潘乔正在山上的一座庄园里参加万圣节派对。米基决心承认对朱莉娅的长期迷恋，朱莉娅是大学高年级同学，也是聚会的主持人。当朱莉娅走开时，米基跟着她来到地下室，那里有令人震惊的秘密等待着。
